# teams_acs_federation_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing AcsFederationConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_acs_resources` (String) Maps to the -AllowedAcsResources parameter.
- `enable_acs_users` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableAcsUsers parameter.
- `hide_banner_for_allowed_acs_users` (Boolean) Maps to the -HideBannerForAllowedAcsUsers parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `label_for_allowed_acs_users` (String) Maps to the -LabelForAllowedAcsUsers parameter.
- `require_acs_federation_for_meeting` (Boolean) Maps to the -RequireAcsFederationForMeeting parameter.
